Implemented `payments_between` in `ledgerly/reporting.py`:

- Normalizes boundaries and payment timestamps to aware UTC via `ensure_utc`.
- Filters to the half-open window `[start, end)`.
- Skips payments with no `created_at`.
- Sorts results oldest-first by `created_at`.
- Keeps the function short with parsing in a private `_parse` helper, per the notes.

All 10 tests pass, including an edge case with mixed timezone offsets.
